protocol.scope: Short end-to-end execution-stack throughput comparison with real SAC/DPPO updates; not matched-learning-work, sample-efficiency, policy-quality, or algorithm-only causal comparison.

defaults.checkpoint_saves: skip every _save, including final, only via explicit benchmark flag

diffusion_policy.hardware: local GPU0 simulation; local GPU1 frozen inference + SAC

vlajepa.hardware: local GPU0 simulation; local GPU1 frozen inference + SAC

walloss.hardware: local GPU0 simulation; H200 GPU1 frozen inference; H200 GPU2 SAC

protocol.full_loop: Native learner run start through final complete batch/round, services already ready; includes initialization and random/critic warmup respectively. Exclude shutdown, record separately. Same transition budget N per model.
protocol.common_window: Use completed boundary after transition common_start through completed boundary common_end, including all reset/encoding/bookkeeping and native learning already performed at those boundaries. For DPPO recompute only from sealed phase round_end[k] to round_end[last]; preserve original reports. DSRL use after-batch marker (post reset/update/save-skip), not first step-only timer.
protocol.warmup: For64-sized batches and learning_starts2000, first32 batches/2048transitions use random clipped Gaussian initial-noise actions. The crossing batch1984->2048 earns64credits after insertion; first trainable-policy action starts at t2048. Do not suppress this warmup or drain remaining credit on shutdown.
algorithm_differences: DSRL updates a small external SAC actor plus five-Q ensemble and temperature, keeping base model frozen. DPPO updates action expert and critic, verifies denoising likelihood and publishes expert weights. No forced synchronization cost is added to DSRL.

DSRL native scheduler asynchronously overlaps up to16 updates per outstanding RPC and up to16 at each loop tail. Maxbacklog1000 can drop credit. Record generated/executed/backlogged/dropped credit; configured UTD is not achieved UTD.

GenericTrainer resets all finished env_ids in one RPC with its native RNG stream. DPPO frozen trainer resets completed envs individually with per-env seeds. Same seed is not identical trajectory/scene exposure. Preserve both, report reset calls and number of reset environments/episode outcomes.

Native DSRL initial noise has noise_steps temporal controls tiled to horizon; VLA1,Wall32,DP16(full horizon newly chosen for DP). This is not the denoising iteration count. Warmup and policy values are scaled1.5; full Wall latent width20 is retained.

DSRL native DP decoder DDIM K10 eta0/min_std0; prior DPPO stochastic chain uses min_std0.02. VLA DSRL native K4 Euler vs DPPO fixed positive transition_std0.002; Wall native BF16 K10 flow vs DPPO FP32 stochastic latent chain std0.03 and canonicalB8/token256 scoring. Do not add Gaussian path likelihood requirements to DSRL or modify native sampler to mimic DPPO.

Wall native decode may use actual token length and configured cache semantics; preserve resolved config and report them alongside DPPOcanonicalB8/context256. No new canonical adapter or speed-driven cache change for this comparison.

Exact task/simulator/model/checkpoint config should copy previous DPPO evidence, not public DSRL examples. Public PAP DSRL example enables fused/state-only/B64/cache optimizations that are not the matched IO protocol.
timing_rules: DSRL RPC and learner intervals overlap. Do not stack rpc_seconds+learner_seconds or interpret the total as exclusive wall time.

Instrument actual I/O client.call in its I/O thread and _learn_one on main thread with monotonic bounds; compute interval unions/intersections. A _call parent measures wall wait including any main-thread update that outlives I/O completion.

Within a common UTC/monotonic window, split I/O-only, learner-only, I/O+learner overlap, and neither as a wall-time partition. If reporting per-route I/O, split each route by its learner intersection; no simultaneous I/O futures exist in this native scheduler.
Keep inclusive costs for operation workload separately; call count, actual SACupdates, actor/alpha steps, and update batch256 are necessary for context.

GPU sampled utilization and device VRAM capacity occupancy are separate; use complete common windows for resource selection, with H200/local clock receipts. A low utilization value is not a causal CPU profile.
required_integrity: Fresh initialization no resume; initial/final SAC actor and Q hashes differ after actual updates; final base checkpoint identity unchanged and no weights_publish endpoint used.
num_envs64 verified; no task reward/termination/horizon/smoothing/render changes; same task distributions with documented different reset RNG streams.

Actual U=learner.updates; actor steps=floor(U/policy_freq) and alpha same when auto_alpha; window counts use floor(Uend/f)-floor(Ustart/f). Q optimizer step is one update for the whole five-Q ensemble, not five separate minibatches.
Final U+backlog+dropped must equal generated credit N-1984 at UTD1,64fullbatches. No save payload, no artificial backlog drain; report final backlog/dropped even if nonzero.
All actual RPC/learning intervals and batch-boundary markers recorded; pending/failed calls must not be converted into successful samples. Stop/release own run and GPU services after benchmark.

scope: Short actual-training throughput runs; no new policy evaluation or convergence claim.
